notes: raster_texture.c's mip generation mirrors func_147943_a/func_147949_a's gamma math, which is why the atlas mip levels match the oracle byte-for-byte; verified only by reading both sources, not by a dedicated test. updateAnaglyph is dead in this game (no anaglyph setting in agent mode). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): GL plumbing: GL is the numerical oracle, not emitted (SPEC); atlases and meshes are consumed as data. Formerly listed as missing: All GL calls (glTexImage2D/glTexSubImage2D, filter/wrap/anisotropy parameters, bind/delete) and the missingno texture: the native renderer keeps the finished atlas as a file-backed mip chain instead (raster_texture_load reads atlas.rgba plus pre-made mip levels).
